summary: Creates a DAT input connector on a Component so external DAT data can enter an encapsulated network through the component boundary.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Name shown on the Component input connector

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: In DAT is a component-boundary connector, not a standalone data generator.
Component DAT inputs are positioned in alphanumeric order along the left side of the parent Component.
Disconnecting an input can leave contents instanced to the original input, so generated cleanup should verify references.
Pair In DAT with matching external wiring or Out DAT structure when building reusable components.
key_concepts: Creates a DAT input connector on a component boundary.
Input connectors appear on the left side of the component and are ordered alphanumerically.
The Label parameter controls the connector label shown in the component UI.
Disconnected In DATs can retain instanced contents from the former input until the network is cleaned up.
